analysis: E27 output uncertainty: logistic-coefficient uncertainty propagated to harmonized country totals (2012 onwards)

included: sampling uncertainty of the logistic coefficients b0, b1 (H3 res-5 cluster bootstrap of the 2012-2018 training detections), with kappa re-derived from each bootstrap curve by the published kappa rule
not_included: sampling uncertainty of kappa itself (no interval estimated)
model-form / structural error of the harmonization
detection-level FIRMS errors, cloud and omission
uncertainty of observed Aqua counts before 2012 (shown as observed, no interval)

method: H3 res-5 cluster bootstrap (Poisson(1) cell weights) of the 2012-2018 Suomi-NPP training detections with the published match labels; logistic refit per draw; kappa re-derived per draw by the published rule (own-kappa countries) or held at the pooled value; point = published fit, reproduced exactly
